english: Who did not feed the fire? You were lying beside it, husband. I am tired; I was working. I spun wool and cooked porridge. And am I not tired? Then let us both be cold. Bring wood, and I will kindle the fire. I will bring it; you are hard. Go, man, and do not lie down on the road!

english: Of-Good-Horses, what was the name of our first daughter? Have you forgotten it? You are old! I remember it. Do you remember it? Our daughter was Of-Divine-Race. That was the other daughter. Then you are wiser than I. And you are more beautiful than I.

english: Son-in-law, you have not paid the bride-price. I led three oxen to your house. Three oxen? They were small and weak. And your daughter devours much. Do not scold my daughter! english: Daughter-in-law, the porridge burned in the pot, and your husband is hungry. Mother, I was at the spring, and I carried water. You talk with the women at the spring. And you are a good mother to me.

english: Master, why did you cut me a small portion? All the portions are alike. I slew the beast. The greatest portion is for the strongest man. Then seize the greatest portion. But sing us the deed. I will sing it, and you will praise me. We will praise you, if you do not lie.

pie: h₂yúHn̥ḱe moy bʰardʰéh₂s kéh₂nmn̥ dh₂pnóy kh₂nés. h₁íd kh₂nóm wiHrṓs-kʷe sméyn̥t. nu moy h₁íd kh₂né. bʰardʰéh₂ toy dl̥h₁gʰéh₂ albʰéh₂-kʷe h₂éwis-kʷe h₁ésyeh₂i h₁én tḱéyti. tód kéh₂nmn̥ h₁wésu. éti smḗymi. ne me h₃eh₃ódth₂e? ne te h₃eh₃ódh₂e. m̥ǵh₂és toy úderosyo kéh₂nmn̥ dh₂pnóy kh₂nṓh₂.
english: Young man, at the feast you sang a song about my beard. I sang it, and the men laughed. Sing it to me now! "Your beard is long and white, and a bird dwells in it." That is a good song.
